sections.body:
## Why a rescue plan must be proven

A worker hanging unconscious in a harness must be brought down within minutes. Relying on help from off site is almost always too slow. Every job at height therefore needs a rescue plan written for that site and already drilled — we cover this in our article [an untested rescue plan is not a plan](/en/tested-rescue-plan/).

## What we do on site

Our standby team arrives with inspected rescue equipment, joins the daily briefing with your workers, and is ready to act throughout the job. We can also test your existing rescue plan and recommend improvements.

## Work-at-height safety support

For contractors and site owners, we help prepare work-at-height safety documents — risk assessments, permits to work, and checklists — in line with Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016.

sections.title: Four steps from survey to report

items.title: 1. Survey & quotation
items.text: We review the site or your photos and drawings, then send the scope, method, schedule, and a written quotation.

items.title: 2. Work plan & permits
items.text: A risk assessment, method statement, and rescue plan are prepared before work starts; permits are arranged with the site manager.

items.title: 3. Delivery
items.text: A team of Kemnaker-certified technicians works with a supervisor on site; the area below the work zone is secured.

items.title: 4. Report & handover
items.text: Before-and-after photos and a work report are handed over with recommendations for the next maintenance cycle.

items.q: When does a project need standby rescue?
items.a: Every job at height needs on-site rescue capability. Standby rescue is most needed when the working team has no competent rescuer of its own, or for high-risk work such as shutdowns and high-rise construction.

items.q: Can you test our existing rescue plan?
items.a: Yes. We run it on the actual site with the equipment available, time it, and give written recommendations.

items.q: How long can the standby team stay?
items.a: Flexibly — daily, weekly, or for the whole project, matched to your schedule.

sections.title: Tell us about the job
sections.text: Send the location, the type of building or asset, and your target dates. We reply with a written quotation, usually the same working day.
